reason: This plugin is primarily a workspace context-selection tool for DeepSeek Harness conversations: it adds a Files tab with a file tree and viewer, lets users pick code snippets or whole files, and automatically injects those selections into outgoing message context. Evidence in the README and package manifest shows no code-generation, execution, or external service integration, but it does expose file read/list behavior through same-origin host endpoints, so its main risk is controlled local file-read context sharing rather than system modification.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在会话界面提供“文件/Files”面板，可浏览工作区文件树并选择代码片段或整文件，发送消息时自动将所选内容作为上下文附加到对话。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness web plugin adds a Files panel to conversations so you can browse workspace files, pick code snippets or whole files, and automatically attach the selected content as context when sending a message.

capabilities: Display workspace file tree and read-only file viewer in DeepSeek Harness web UI
List and read workspace files through same-origin host routes
Attach selected file snippets or whole files as message context via input codec at send time
Show and clear a selection chip UI in the composer

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a Codex-style file/code selector for DeepSeek Harness Web with workspace file tree plus file viewer and automatic context attachment.
README describes host routes `GET /dsh-codex-select/list|read` and emphasizes read-only access with UTF-8 text limit and binary rejection.
README notes same-origin host routes using the core directory picker trust model for listing/reading absolute paths.
